Two other bits from my meeting with the client: the shop cat Biscuit sleeps in the window and is famous round the neighbourhood, and someone said the owner's favourite book is about a fox. A sleeping cat or a fox could work too, but the fox is only hearsay, so I'd go elephant. Your call though.",

  "notes": "Leo says the client is tired of owls and wants a change, so owl is probably out. Leo suggested elephant and I backed it. I shared the Biscuit and fox notes as alternatives. Priya decides. Wait for her sketch, then trace the strokes she assigns. Don't take the pad."
